app_fee.value: The regular research-degree fee is HK$500 on the 2026/27 fee page. The 2027/28 HKPFS route also publishes HK$500 per programme, subject to revision. The regular 2027/28 amount is not confirmed.
app_fee.quote: The application fees for 2026-27 entry are as follows:

also.quote: A non-refundable application fee of HK$500 (~US$64) (subject to revision) will be charged for each application for a programme.

fee_waiver.value: No 2027/28 application-fee waiver policy for international research-degree applicants was located. Tuition scholarships are separate.

gre_general.value: The graduate handbook allows GRE or GMAT scores as supplementary information if available. These scores do not meet the English proficiency requirement.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examinations (GRE)/Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) scores are not accepted in fulfilment of the University’s English proficiency requirement for research degree programmes, but can be submitted as supplementary information for reference if available.

toefl_min.value: The general TOEFL iBT floor is 4.5 from 21 January 2026, or 79 on the previous scale. The College of Science publishes separate score wording. See the programme record for the applicable assessment.
toefl_min.quote: a score of 79 (for tests taken prior to 21 January 2026) or 4.5 (for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards) (Internet-based test) in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)

also.quote: TOEFL and IELTS scores are considered valid for two years from the test date and must be valid at the time of submission of application.

ielts_min.value: CityUHK lists IELTS 6.5 overall. The application notes exclude IELTS Indicator, One Skill Retake and IELTS Online.
ielts_min.quote: an overall band score of 6.5 in International English Language Testing System (IELTS)

also.quote: ‘IELTS Indicator’, ‘IELTS One Skill Retake’ and ‘IELTS Online’ are not acceptable.

english_waiver.value: The university test requirement applies when the entrance qualification was taught in a language other than English. For HKPFS, a candidate from a non-English-speaking university must document English as the language of instruction for every course that qualifies them for admission.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants from non-English speaking universities are required to attach their TOEFL or IELTS score results with their PhD applications, unless they can provide proof that English is the language of instruction for all courses that qualify them for entrance to their proposed PhD programmes.

also.quote: Applicants whose entrance qualification is obtained from an institution where the medium of instruction is not English should fulfill the following minimum English proficiency requirement

notes: Research-degree catalogue: https://www.cityu.edu.hk/pg/current/catalogue/catalogue_R.htm?page=R/R_programme_index.htm. CityUHK distinguishes government-funded and self-financing admission. HKPFS is a separate competitive route for new full-time PhD applicants, irrespective of nationality. The 2027/28 fellowship pays HK$28,700 per month for up to three years, with matching fourth-year support from CityUHK for awardees admitted to a four-year PhD. Check the published award terms for entrance scholarship, travel and fee details: https://www.cb.cityu.edu.hk/en/pg/hong-kong-phd-fellowship-scheme/about-the-scheme.
